## Collegiate Sports

- The data comes from [Equity in Athletics Data Analysis](https://ope.ed.gov/athletics/#/datafile/list), via TidyTuesday

```{r Load Data}

# Download File
sports_raw <- read_csv(
  here("GoodPlotBadPlot", 
       "Data", 
       "sports.csv"))

# head(sports_raw)

# Same ~2,075 institutions every year, but 2019 carries 3.6x the rows.
sports_raw |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    rows            = n(),
    institutions    = n_distinct(unitid),
    pct_no_athletes = percent(mean(sum_partic_men + sum_partic_women == 0)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "2019 is padded with rows for sports that aren't offered") |>
  kable_classic()
  
# Clean Data
sports_clean <- sports_raw |>
  filter(sum_partic_men + sum_partic_women > 0) |>
  mutate(
    year_label = paste0(year, "-", str_sub(year + 1, 3, 4)),
    .after = year)
nrow(sports_raw) - nrow(sports_clean)

# head(sports_clean)
```

```{r Creating Data Frame of DI-FBS Institutions in 2019}
# Using the cleaned data, filter for year of interest
fbs_2019 <- sports_clean |>
  filter(year == 2019, classification_name == "NCAA Division I-FBS")

per_athlete <- fbs_2019 |>
  group_by(sports) |>
  summarise(
    across(
      c(sum_partic_men, sum_partic_women, exp_men, exp_women),
      function(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  # Only a sport with a real program of both sexes supports a comparison.
  # Also guards the division: a single-sex sport would give 0 / 0 = NaN.
  
  filter(sum_partic_men >= 100, sum_partic_women >= 100) |>
  transmute(
    sport   = sports,
    men     = exp_men   / sum_partic_men,
    women   = exp_women / sum_partic_women,
    n_men   = sum_partic_men,
    n_women = sum_partic_women
  )

per_athlete |>
  arrange(desc(men / women)) |>
  mutate(across(c(men, women), label_dollar(accuracy = 1))) |>
  kable(caption = "Expenditure per participant, NCAA Division I, 2019-20",
        col.names = c(
      "Sport",
      "Expenditure per Male",
      "Expenditure per Female",
      "Male Participants",
      "Female Participants")) |>
  kable_classic()
```

### Analysis I: Gender Spending Gap
```{r Dissecting Gender Spending Gap}
# Pool every FBS institution, then divide total dollar by total participants
# Taking a mean of per-school ratios instead would weight a 300-athlete
# programme the same as a 900-athlete one.

scope_ratio <- function(data, exclude = character()) {
  data |>
    filter(!sports %in% exclude) |> # This filter allows me to make a column later on to exclude certain sports for analyses
    summarise(
      across(c(sum_partic_men, sum_partic_women, exp_men, exp_women),
             function(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE))
    ) |>
    transmute(
      men   = exp_men   / sum_partic_men,
      women = exp_women / sum_partic_women,
      ratio = men / women
    )
}

# Now let's make the column of sports for later exclusion analyses
decomp <- bind_rows(
  scope_ratio(fbs_2019)                              |> mutate(scope = "All sports"),
  scope_ratio(fbs_2019, "Football")                  |> mutate(scope = "Excluding football"),
  scope_ratio(fbs_2019, c("Football", "Basketball")) |> mutate(scope = "Excluding football\nand basketball")
) |>
  mutate(scope = fct_rev(fct_inorder(scope))) # This function allows modification of the scope column, in order

# Now we want wide to long format for the plot

decomp_long <- decomp |>
  pivot_longer(c(men, women), names_to = "sex", values_to = "per_athlete") |>
  mutate(icon = if_else(sex == "men",
                        fontawesome("fa-male"),
                        fontawesome("fa-female")))

# Make the plot

twosport_plot <- ggplot(decomp_long, aes(x = per_athlete, y = scope)) +
  geom_segment(
    data = decomp, inherit.aes = FALSE,
    aes(x = men, xend = women, y = scope, yend = scope),
    colour = "grey78", linewidth = 1.3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = icon, 
        color = sex),
    family = "fontawesome-webfont",
    size = 6) +
  geom_text(
    data = decomp, inherit.aes = FALSE,
    aes(x = pmax(men, women), y = scope,
        label = paste0(number(ratio, accuracy = 0.01), "x")),
    hjust = -0.4, size = 3.3, colour = "grey30", fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = filter(decomp_long, scope == "All sports"),
    aes(label = str_to_title(sex), color = sex),
    nudge_y = 0.33, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(men = "#99CCD9", women = "#EC1A7F"),
                               guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_dollar(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "k", accuracy = 1),
                     limits = c(0, 1.4e5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.6, 0.9))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Two Sports Account for Gender Spending Gap in D-I Football Schools",
    subtitle = "Operating expenditure per participant, NCAA Division I-FBS, 2019-20. Ratio is men's spending divided by women's.",
    x = "Expenditure per participant", y = NULL,
    caption  = "Data: EADA, US Dept of Education, via TidyTuesday 2022-03-29. 127 institutions."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor    = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y  = element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption  = element_text(hjust = 0, colour = "grey45", size = 7.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 9.5)
  )

twosport_plot
```

### Analysis II: Title IX

```{r Data Frame with Enrollment and Participation}
# Title IX Data Frame

title_ix <- sports_clean |>
  filter(year == 2019) |>
  group_by(unitid, classification_name) |>
  summarise(
    athletes_men   = sum(sum_partic_men,   na.rm = TRUE),
    athletes_women = sum(sum_partic_women, na.rm = TRUE),
    students_men   = first(ef_male_count),
    students_women = first(ef_female_count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(classification_name) |>
  summarise(
    schools        = n(),
    pct_students_w = sum(students_women) / sum(students_men + students_women),
    pct_athletes_w = sum(athletes_women) / sum(athletes_men + athletes_women),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(schools >= 20) |>
  mutate(
    gap = pct_athletes_w - pct_students_w,
    classification_name = fct_reorder(classification_name, gap)
  ) 

# Make the plot

title_ix_plot <- ggplot(title_ix, aes(y = classification_name)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = pct_students_w, xend = pct_athletes_w,
        y = classification_name, yend = classification_name),
    colour = "grey72", linewidth = 0.9,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.028, "npc"), type = "closed")
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = pct_students_w), color = "#ff0069", size = 2.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = pct_athletes_w), color = "#18B587", size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(data = slice_max(title_ix, gap, n = 1),
            aes(x = pct_students_w, 
                label = "Student Share",
                hjust = -0.05),
            nudge_y = 0.5, 
            size = 2.9, 
            color = "#ff0069", 
            fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = slice_max(title_ix, gap, n = 1),
            aes(x = pct_athletes_w, 
                label = "Athlete Share",
                hjust = 2.2),
            nudge_y = 0.5, 
            size = 2.9, 
            color = "#18B587", 
            fontface = "bold") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
                     limits = c(0.32, 0.63), breaks = seq(0.35, 0.60, 0.05)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.6, 1.1))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Women are the majority of students, and a minority of athletes, in every division",
    subtitle = "Arrow Runs from Women's Share of Enrollment to Share of Athletes, 2019-20",
    x = "Women Share of Total", y = NULL,
    caption  = "Data: EADA, US Dept of Education, via TidyTuesday"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor    = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y  = element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption  = element_text(hjust = 0, colour = "grey45", size = 7.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 9.5)
  )

title_ix_plot
```

### Analysis III: Division Cascade

```{r Revenues per Division Classification}
# Make data frame for different institutions' division classifications

by_class <- sports_clean |>
  filter(year == 2019) |>
  group_by(classification_name) |>
  summarise(
    schools  = n_distinct(unitid),
    athletes = sum(sum_partic_men + sum_partic_women, na.rm = TRUE),
    expense  = sum(total_exp_menwomen, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    per_athlete = expense / athletes,
    classification_name = fct_reorder(classification_name, per_athlete)
  )

# Classification Plot

class_plot <- ggplot(by_class, aes(x = per_athlete, y = classification_name)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 2000, 
                   xend = per_athlete,
                   y = classification_name, 
                   yend = classification_name),
               color = "grey82", 
               linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(size = athletes), 
             color = "#99CCD9", 
             alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label_dollar(accuracy = 1)(per_athlete)),
            hjust = -0.35, size = 2.7, color = "grey35") +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(2500, 5000, 10000, 25000, 50000, 100000),
    labels = label_dollar(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "k", accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(2000, 2.4e5), expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 7, labels = label_comma(), name = "Athletes") +
  labs(
    title    = "A Division I-FBS athlete costs 33 times what a junior-college athlete costs",
    subtitle = "Operating expenditure per athlete by classification, 2019-20. Point area is the number of athletes",
    x = "Expenditure per participant", y = NULL,
    caption  = "Data: EADA, US Dept of Education, via TidyTuesday"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor     = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y   = element_line(
      color = "grey94",
      linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.position      = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "left",
    plot.title.position  = "plot",
    plot.caption  = element_text(
      hjust = 0, 
      color = "grey45", 
      size = 7.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey35", size = 9.5)
  )

class_plot
```

### Analysis IV: UH Manoa Specific
```{r Load Rainbow Warriors}

UH <- 141574 # University of Hawai'i at Manoa

UH <- sports_clean |>
  filter(unitid == UH)
  
UH |> distinct(year,
           classification_name,
           ef_male_count,
           ef_female_count)

# Sailing is a COED program, should filter for analyses
UH |> filter(sports == "Sailing") |>
  select(year,
         sports,
         partic_men, 
         partic_coed_men,
         partic_coed_women,
         sum_partic_men,
         sum_partic_women,
         exp_men,
         exp_women)

```
```{r Benchmark against other D1 FBS}

benchmark <- bind_rows(
  sports_clean |> filter(year == 2019, 
                         unitid == 141574) |>
    mutate(group = "UH Manoa"),
  sports_clean |> filter(year == 2019, 
                         classification_name == "NCAA Division 1-FBS") |>
    mutate(group = 
             "All Division I-FBS")
) |>
  group_by(group, unitid) |>
  summarise(
    athletes_m = sum(sum_partic_men,   na.rm = TRUE),
    athletes_w = sum(sum_partic_women, na.rm = TRUE),
    exp_m      = sum(exp_men,   na.rm = TRUE),
    exp_w      = sum(exp_women, na.rm = TRUE),
    students_m = first(ef_male_count),     # institution-level, repeated per row
    students_w = first(ef_female_count),
    .groups = "drop_last"
  ) |>
  summarise(
    pct_students_w = sum(students_w) / sum(students_m + students_w),
    pct_athletes_w = sum(athletes_w) / sum(athletes_m + athletes_w),
    per_man        = sum(exp_m) / sum(athletes_m),
    per_woman      = sum(exp_w) / sum(athletes_w),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(spend_ratio = per_man / per_woman)

benchmark
```

```{r UH Sport Gap}
UH_sport <- UH |>
  filter(year == 2019, sports != "Sailing") |>   # coed, see above
  transmute(
    sport     = sports,
    men       = if_else(sum_partic_men   > 0, exp_men   / sum_partic_men,   NA_real_),
    women     = if_else(sum_partic_women > 0, exp_women / sum_partic_women, NA_real_),
    n_men     = sum_partic_men,
    n_women   = sum_partic_women,
    total_exp = coalesce(exp_men, 0) + coalesce(exp_women, 0)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    sport   = fct_reorder(sport, total_exp),
    n_label = paste0(n_men, " / ", n_women)
  )

# Sports with both programs get a connector; single-sex sports get one point.
UH_pairs <- UH_sport |> filter(!is.na(men), !is.na(women))

UH_long <- UH_sport |>
  pivot_longer(c(men, women), names_to = "sex", values_to = "per_athlete") |>
  filter(!is.na(per_athlete)) |>
  mutate(icon = if_else(sex == "men",
                        fontawesome("fa-male"),
                        fontawesome("fa-female")))

UH_sports_plot <- ggplot(UH_long, aes(x = per_athlete, y = sport)) +
  geom_segment(
    data = UH_pairs, inherit.aes = FALSE,
    aes(x = men, xend = women, y = sport, yend = sport),
    color = "grey78", linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = icon, 
        color = sex),
    family = "fontawesome-webfont",
    size = 6) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sex), size = 0.5) +
  geom_text(
    data = UH_sport, inherit.aes = FALSE,
    aes(x = 2.6e5, y = sport, label = n_label),
    hjust = 1, size = 2.6, color = "grey45"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 2.6e5, y = 12.7, hjust = 1, size = 2.6,
           color = "grey35", fontface = "italic",
           label = "athletes (m / w)") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(men = "#99CCD9", women = "#EC1A7F"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_dollar(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "k", accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, 2.7e5), expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.6, 1.3))) +
  labs(
    title    = "At UH Manoa, women are 56% of athletes and receive 35% of the athletics budget",
    subtitle = "Operating expenditure per participant by sport, 2019-20",
    x = "Expenditure per participant", y = NULL,
    caption = paste(
      "Data: Equity in Athletics Data Analysis (EADA), US Dept of Education, via TidyTuesday 2022-03-29.",
      "Sailing is excluded: it is a coed programme that EADA's gendered columns cannot represent.",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor    = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y  = element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption  = element_text(hjust = 0, color = "grey45", size = 7,
                                 lineheight = 1.25),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 9.5)
  )
```

```{r UH 5-year Trend}
UH_trend <- UH |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    per_man   = sum(exp_men,   na.rm = TRUE) / sum(sum_partic_men,   na.rm = TRUE),
    per_woman = sum(exp_women, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(sum_partic_women, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(ratio = per_man / per_woman)

UH_trend_long <- UH_trend |>
  pivot_longer(c(per_man, per_woman), names_to = "sex", values_to = "per_athlete")

ggplot(UH_trend_long, aes(x = year, y = per_athlete, color = sex)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  geom_text(
    data = filter(UH_trend_long, year == 2019),
    aes(label = if_else(sex == "per_man", "Men", "Women")),
    hjust = -0.3, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(per_man = "#99CCD9", per_woman = "#EC1A7F"),
                      guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2015:2019, labels = paste0(2015:2019, "-", 16:20),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.14))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_dollar(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "k", accuracy = 1),
                     limits = c(0, 1e5)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Five years, no convergence",
    subtitle = "UH Manoa operating expenditure per participant. The men-to-women ratio moved from 2.24 to 2.36.",
    x = NULL, y = "Expenditure per participant",
    caption = "Data: EADA, US Dept of Education, via TidyTuesday"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor    = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x  = element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption  = element_text(hjust = 0, colour = "grey45", size = 7.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 9.5)
  )

```
```{r UH vs. FBS 5-Year Trend}
#| warning: FALSE

trend_of <- function(data, label) {
  data |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarise(
      men   = sum(exp_men,   na.rm = TRUE) / sum(sum_partic_men,   na.rm = TRUE),
      women = sum(exp_women, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(sum_partic_women, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(group = label)
}

trend <- bind_rows(
  trend_of(filter(sports_clean, classification_name == "NCAA Division I-FBS"),
           "All Division I-FBS"),
  trend_of(filter(sports_clean, unitid == 141574), "UH Manoa")
) |>
  pivot_longer(c(men, women), names_to = "sex", values_to = "per_athlete")

trend <- trend |>
  mutate(series = 
           paste(group, sex, sep = " / "))

trend <- trend |>
  group_by(group, sex) |>
  arrange(year, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    base = per_athlete[year == 2015],
    pct_change = per_athlete / base - 1,
    tip = paste0(
      group, " \u2014 ", sex, "<br>",
      year, "-", str_sub(year + 1, 3, 4), "<br>",
      label_dollar(accuracy = 1)(per_athlete), " per participant<br>",
      "Since 2015-16: ", percent(pct_change, accuracy = 0.1))) |>
  ungroup()

# Make Good Plot
UHvsFBS_plot <- ggplot(
  trend, 
  aes(x = year, 
      y = per_athlete,
      color = series, 
      linetype = group,
      group = interaction(group, sex))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.1) +
  geom_text(
    data = filter(trend, year == 2019) |>
      mutate(x_lab = year + 0.3),
    aes(x = x_lab,
        label = paste0(if_else(group == "UH Manoa", "UH ", "All FBS "), sex)),
    hjust = 0, vjust = -0.1, size = 3, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = filter(trend, year == 2019) |> mutate(x_lab = year + 0.3),
    aes(x = x_lab,
        label = paste0(if_else(pct_change >= 0, "+", ""),
                       percent(pct_change, accuracy = 0.1))),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1.3, size = 2.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  # Two channels, one variable each: color carries sex, line style carries group.
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "UH Manoa / men" = "#024731", 
      "UH Manoa / women" = "#6C41D3",
      "All Division I-FBS / men" = "#024731", alpha = 0.7,
      "All Division I-FBS / women" = "#6C41D3", alpha = 0.7),
                      guide = "none") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("UH Manoa" = "solid",
                                   "All Division I-FBS" = "dashed"),
                        guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2015:2019,
                     labels = paste0(2015:2019, "-", 16:20),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.26))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_dollar(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "k", accuracy = 1),
                     limits = c(0, 1.3e5),
                     breaks = seq(0, 125000, 25000)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Division I-FBS vs. UH Manoa Spending per Athlete, 5-Year Trend",
    subtitle = "Normalized operating expenditure rose 22% for all other D-I schools, Rainbow Warriors did not",
    x = NULL, y = "Expenditure per participant",
    caption = paste(
      "Data: Equity in Athletics Data Analysis (EADA), US Dept of Education, via TidyTuesday",
      "Restricting the comparison to the 125 institutions classified as FBS in all five years changes every figure by under 1%, so the trend is not an artefact of schools changing division",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor    = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x  = element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption  = element_text(hjust = 0, color = "grey45", size = 7,
                                 lineheight = 1.25),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey35", size = 9.5)
  )

UHvsFBS_plot
```

```{r Bad Plot}
bad_dat <- bind_rows(

            .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_longer(c(exp_men,
                 exp_women),
               names_to = "sex",
               values_to = "total_exp")

bad_plot <- ggplot(bad_dat,
                   aes(x = factor(year),
                       y = total_exp,
                       fill = sex)) +
geom_col(aes(y = total_exp),
           position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
           width = 0.85, fill = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_col_pattern(
    aes(pattern_filename = sex),
    pattern        = "image",
    pattern_type   = "tile",
    pattern_scale  = 0.05, 
    fill           = "white",
    colour         = "yellow",
    linewidth      = 0.6,
    position       = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    width          = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_pattern_filename_manual(
    values = c(
      exp_men   = here("GoodPlotBadPlot", "dolla.png"),
      exp_women = here("GoodPlotBadPlot", "pinkdolla.png"))) +
  facet_wrap(~ group) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(exp_men = "#1E90FF", exp_women = "#FF69B4")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels   = label_scientific(),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / 1e6, name = "Millions")
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "UH Manoa Spends Nothing on Athletics",
    subtitle = "Expenditure by year",
    x = "Year", y = "Expenditure",
    caption  = "source: trust me, bro"                           # CRIME: no source, no n
  ) +
  theme_grey(base_family = "Comic Sans MS") +
  theme(
    panel.ontop      = TRUE,
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "#39FF14"),
    legend.position  = "top",
    plot.title       = element_text(size = 17, colour = "red", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, size = 6),
    aspect.ratio     = 0.45
  )

bad_plot
```
